title: Idaho budget committee introduces new health and welfare budget with additional cuts
author: Clark Corbin
summary: The Idaho budget committee has introduced a new health and human services budget that includes an additional $21 million in cuts to Medicaid disability services, following the rejection of a previous budget by the Idaho Senate. This reduction will not only impact essential services but also result in the loss of $44 million in federal funding, totaling a $65 million loss for the state. These cuts are part of a broader trend of budget reductions pushed by Idaho Republicans and the governor throughout the 2026 legislative session, raising concerns about the implications for vulnerable populations reliant on these services.
